subsystems.name: Gap detector
subsystems.role: recognises that the current task cannot be completed with the skills already available.
parts: failure classifier reading stack traces and test output
self-critique prompt over the failed attempt

subsystems.name: Skill synthesiser
subsystems.role: writes the missing capability as executable code or a documented procedure.

subsystems.name: Sandboxed runtime
subsystems.role: executes the new script safely, with no way to damage real systems.
parts: file system snapshot and network allowlist

subsystems.name: Verifier
subsystems.role: decides whether the new skill actually works before it is trusted or remembered.

subsystems.name: Skill library
subsystems.role: stores verified skills as reusable, described functions rather than one-off transcripts.

subsystems.name: Orchestrator
subsystems.role: runs the propose–attempt–learn loop and decides what to try next.

buildSteps.title: Choose a verifiable environment
buildSteps.detail: Pick a domain where success or failure is unambiguous — a simulated back-office system, a code repository with a test suite, or a game with a score. Without a cheap automatic check, the loop cannot close.

buildSteps.title: Instrument execution
buildSteps.detail: Give the agent a sandboxed container with an interpreter, a package manager, a scratch file system and controlled access to the target APIs, plus full logging of every action.

buildSteps.title: Run the basic loop
buildSteps.detail: The agent is given a task, proposes a plan, writes code, runs it, and reads back the output and any error. This alone is ordinary tool use, not learning.

buildSteps.title: Add failure attribution
buildSteps.detail: When a run fails, the system classifies why — wrong API, wrong argument, missing permission, bad logic — so the next attempt changes the right thing rather than retrying blindly.

buildSteps.title: Curate before committing to memory
buildSteps.detail: Only skills that pass their tests are saved, deduplicated against existing entries, and rewritten as a documented function with an explicit signature. Junk in the library poisons later retrieval.

buildSteps.title: Build retrieval and composition
buildSteps.detail: Index the library by description so the planner can pull in the right skill and chain two or three together to solve a task none of them solves alone.

buildSteps.title: Generate the next task
buildSteps.detail: The curriculum generator proposes a task just beyond the agent's current reach, based on which skills exist and which attempts recently failed.

buildSteps.title: Add regression and safety gates
buildSteps.detail: Re-run older task suites after every library change to catch skills that overwrite or break earlier ones, and cap what the agent may do to real systems without human approval.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models that write reliable code
prerequisites.why: the synthesised skill is usually a script, so code quality sets the ceiling on everything else.

prerequisites.tech: Cheap sandboxed execution and tool APIs
prerequisites.why: the loop needs thousands of attempts, which must be safe and nearly free.
tests and scores exist for code and games but not for most white-collar tasks, which is the central bottleneck.
a library is only useful if the right skill is found at the right moment without degrading over time.
an agent that writes and runs its own procedures can also automate its own mistakes.

pathway.milestone: research agents that build and reuse skill libraries inside games and software benchmarks
pathway.unlocks: proof that the loop can raise success rates without humans writing each new capability.

pathway.milestone: closed-domain assistants that propose new skills with human review before they are committed
pathway.unlocks: use in document processing, data entry and IT operations where output is checkable.

pathway.milestone: self-curated libraries with continuous regression testing
pathway.unlocks: agents that keep improving on long-running workflows without drifting into error.

pathway.milestone: transfer of skills between domains and agents
pathway.unlocks: capability growth that compounds across an organisation, but also makes oversight and auditability the binding constraint.
